bm.guard_bolt.wind._orig: PROVISIONAL: the guard readying a measured bolt: the open palm drawn back to the shoulder, the other hand open at his chest, both feet planted

bm.guard_bolt.fire._orig: PROVISIONAL: the bolt leaving: the open palm thrown flat to shoulder height, the feet where they were

bm.guard_bolt.settle._orig: PROVISIONAL: back to the stance, the hand open

bm.hold.charge_protagonist._orig: PROVISIONAL: the Protagonist charging a beam: side-on with the weight back, one arm drawn back at shoulder height and the open palm at the shoulder facing forward, flat, the other hand open in guard at the chest a shoulder width away; nothing held in the hand

bm.hold.fire_protagonist._orig: PROVISIONAL: the Protagonist casting: the arm thrown straight out at shoulder height with the heel of the open palm leading, the fingers up, the body lunged behind it, the other hand open and low at the rear

bm.hold.charge_antihero._orig: PROVISIONAL: the Anti-hero charging a beam: side-on, the closed fist drawn back along the shoulder line with the forearm plate up, the rear hand open and forward in guard, never pointing; nothing held in the hand

bm.hold.fire_antihero._orig: PROVISIONAL: the Anti-hero casting: the closed fist driven straight out at shoulder height, the forearm plate behind it, the other hand open in guard
